name: theo-memory
description: Persistent, multi-tenant memory for Claude Code, backed by theo-memory. Continuous per-prompt recall, auto-remember, error-context, and MCP read/update/delete parity — all scoped to the credential's Principal (workspace, user) server-side.

memory_url.title: theo-memory URL
memory_url.description: Gateway or REST endpoint (e.g. https://app.usetheo.dev/v1/memory). Set THEOMEM_MEMORY_URL.

memory_token.title: theo-memory API token
memory_token.description: Bearer token; the server resolves the Principal (workspace, user) from it. Set THEOMEM_MEMORY_TOKEN.

hooks.role: per-prompt recall scoped to the Principal (M14)
recall the memory of a failing command (M14)
block writes to MEMORY.md, redirect to remember (M14)
promote durable session memories to the global tier
idempotent import of CLAUDE.md/AGENTS.md as profile memories (M14)

commands.name: /onboard
commands.description: Import this project's CLAUDE.md / AGENTS.md into theo-memory once (idempotent by content hash).
